text:
sarah: FYI - RiverCity CU is ready to start a 30-day POC but compliance is a gating item. They want a slimmed-down proof pack: SOC 2 control mapping (not full report), ISO 27001 cert scope page, a signed pen-test authorization letter, and a short statement on who holds KMS keys during the POC. Also asked for a note on redaction options for logs. They want this before the kickoff call next Tue.

jorge: Got it. Can we confirm whether they need sample evidence (e.g. a single audit log sample) or just pointers to where logs live and retention windows? Delivering a redacted sample is possible but Legal usually prefers pointers + policy excerpts.

priya: I can assemble the SOC2 mapping + access control policy excerpt. Plan: control-to-evidence table + where to find artifacts (s3 presigned, audit-log snippets). I will mark which artifacts are shareable vs redaction-required. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

matt: For KMS: standard options are (A) Redwood-managed keys (we don't export) or (B) customer-managed BYOK for Private/Dedicated. For a short POC we can do a documented KMS custody statement for (A) with a clause about BYOK upgrade path. I'll draft a 2-paragraph custody statement.

legal-bot: NOTE: Legal review required for pen-test authorization. Typical turnaround 48 business hours for minimal signature. Provide target IPs/CIDR and vendor name to speed review.

jorge: Customer asked if external red-team scans are allowed or only authenticated scans. They prefer external vendor. We'll need to list allowed ports and confirm no destructive tests.

priya: I'll include a redaction note: "we can provide logs with PII removed and a hashed identifier for correlation; full raw logs require a signed DPA amendment."

matt: Network diagram: we can create a simplified VPC/Dedicated diagram showing subnets, NAT, load balancer, and egress CIDR. If they confirm Dedicated now we can hand over diagram + assigned /28 within 24-36 hrs.

jorge: Pricing Q: they asked whether Dedicated POC locks rate. Short answer: dedicated reserved capacity requires a commit; we can offer a 60-day trial with a temporary discount if sales signs team exception. I'll pull numbers and propose 30% trial discount for 60 days.

legal-bot: Draft pen-test language suggestion: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor] to perform coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against the following systems: [list IPs/CIDRs]. Testing window: [start] - [end]. Redwood SRE must be notified 72 hours prior and provided a point of contact. All vulnerabilities must be disclosed to Redwood within 24 hours. Tests must not exfiltrate or modify customer data.```

security-bot: Logged as SEC-5021. Please attach target CIDR and vendor contact to ticket for scheduling.

priya: Customer follow-up: "Prefer only policy excerpts + mapping + signed pen letter; do not want raw logs." I'll mark raw logs as out-of-scope unless DPA amendment signed.

matt: I'll draft the KMS custody blurb and the simplified network diagram.

jorge: I'll run pricing with billing ops this afternoon and share a proposal. If we offer a 60-day discounted Dedicated trial we should call it out in the quote.

sarah: Thanks team. Action items: Priya - SOC2 mapping & policy excerpts (EOD tom), Matt - KMS statement + diagram (36 hrs if Dedicated confirmed), Jorge - pricing & quote (today afternoon), Legal - pen-letter sign (48 hrs). I'll update the customer with those timelines and propose a Wed call to close scope.
